author: Zdenek Dvorak
title: List coloring and Gallai trees

verified_results.name: Lemma 7
verified_results.paraphrase: An uncolorable connected degree assignment has equality between list size and degree at every vertex.

verified_results.name: Theorem 10
verified_results.paraphrase: A connected degree assignment is uncolorable precisely for a Gallai tree with blockwise uniform lists.

application: A3 exact original C lists satisfy connected degree-assignment hypotheses; neither external result requires global minimal q-core status.
